title: Field action equivalence with normalized geometric derived sections
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, $k^s/k$ a separable closure, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, $\bar s=\operatorname{Spec}k^s$ and $G=\operatorname{Aut}_k(k^s)$ with the Krull topology. Work in compatible universes making the sites small [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For a profinite set $P$ write $T[P]=\varprojlim_i\coprod_{P_i}T$, over its finite quotients [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-test-object-functor]. Let $R$ be any commutative condensed ring, put $R_T=p_T^*R$, and use internal modules and ordinary unbounded derived categories [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, sk-def-sfb-module-objects, sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Let $\mathcal A_G(R)$ mean internal $R$-modules with an action of the condensed group $P\mapsto C(P,G)$ [def-sfb-condensed-action-module].

There is an exact additive equivalence $E_R:\operatorname{Mod}_{R_s}\simeq\mathcal A_G(R)$ with $(E_RN)(P)=\Gamma(\bar s[P],N|_{\bar s[P]})$. The action comes from the $k$-automorphisms of $k^s$. Its derived equivalence is t-exact. For every coefficient map $R\to R'$, it identifies scalar restriction, ordinary and derived scalar extension, their adjunction units and counits, with those in the action categories. In particular it identifies the canonical coefficient projection for a structure morphism $a:X\to s$ with the morphism $\beta:R'\otimes^L_R\mathcal K_R(M)\to\mathcal K_{R'}(R'_X\otimes^L_{R_X}M)$ for the functors $\mathcal K$ of [lem-sfb-condensed-galois-global-descent], defined as the transpose under the derived scalar adjunction $R'\otimes^L_R-\dashv\operatorname{Res}$ of $\mathcal K_R(M)\xrightarrow{\mathcal K_R(\eta_M)}\mathcal K_R(\operatorname{Res}(R'_X\otimes^L_{R_X}M))\to\operatorname{Res}\mathcal K_{R'}(R'_X\otimes^L_{R_X}M)$, where $\eta_M$ is the derived scalar-extension unit and the second arrow is the canonical comparison of $\mathcal K$ with the exact scalar restriction, and $D(E_R)Ra_*M\cong\mathcal K_R(M)$ canonically for every qcqs $k$-scheme $X$ and $M\in D(R_X)$.

Let $u:X^s=X\times_k k^s\to X$ and let $p_{X^s}$ be the structural geometric morphism from its pro-etale topos to the condensed topos. Forgetting the $G$-action identifies $\mathcal K_R(M)$ with $Rp_{X^s*}u^*M$. Under this identification the forgotten coefficient projection is exactly
$$R'\otimes_R^L Rp_{X^s*}u^*M\longrightarrow Rp_{X^s*}(R'_{X^s}\otimes^L_{R_{X^s}}u^*M),$$
the counit-adjoint projection map. These identifications commute with coefficient restriction, input morphisms and canonical shifts. Forgetting the action is exact and conservative, also on the derived categories.

If $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite with its norm topology and $R(P)=C(P,E)$, $E_R$ restricts to an equivalence between finite-rank lisse $R_s$-modules [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module] and finite-dimensional norm-topological $E$-vector spaces $W$ with continuous $E$-linear $G$-action, realized by $P\mapsto C(P,W)$. Rank zero and trivial $G$ are included.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-field-action-topos-coefficients] to the field and its separable closure: restriction to the dense free-orbit subsite gives the topos equivalence $E:\operatorname{Sh}(s_{\mathrm{proet}})\simeq\operatorname{Cond}^{\underline G}$ over the condensed topos with $(EF)(P)=F(\bar s[P])$, the action induced by right translations on $G=\operatorname{Aut}_k(k^s)$, and $E(R_s)\cong R$ with trivial action as ring objects, naturally in ring maps. By [lem-sfb-geometric-sections-adjunction], module transport gives the exact additive equivalence $E_R:\operatorname{Mod}_{R_s}\simeq\mathcal A_G(R)$ with $(E_RN)(P)=\Gamma(\bar s[P],N|_{\bar s[P]})$, identity-on-sections scalar-restriction comparisons, and its termwise derived equivalence. This is the normalized field data of [def-sfb-field-action-transport-data].

source.place: Example 4.1.10, pp. 27–28; returned proof steps 1–3, now carried by the landed nodes of the global-descent re-split

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-internal-action-site-presentation], applied to the action site of step 1, forgetting the action creates kernels and cokernels and detects the zero module. It is therefore exact and conservative. On complexes it commutes with cohomology; if a derived morphism becomes invertible after forgetting, its cone has zero forgotten cohomology, hence zero cohomology, so the morphism was invertible. The termwise derived equivalence of step 1 is t-exact: exactness of $E_R$ and of its inverse gives $H^n(D(E_R)K)=E_RH^n(K)$ for every $K\in D(R_s)$ and every integer $n$. No bound on $n$ or on $G$ is involved.

Apply [lem-sfb-field-ringed-scalar-adjunction-transport] to this ringed equivalence. The identity-on-sections restriction comparison fixes ordinary scalar adjunctions; its K-flat comparison fixes derived extension and the derived units and counits. Its normalized $\rho_a$ fixes the scalar restriction comparison used below, without flatness of the coefficient map.

source.place: Assembly from extracted returned proof steps 5, 6, 10

proof.text: For each qcqs structure morphism $a:X\to s$, apply [lem-sfb-field-free-orbit-derived-slice-sections]. The identity $X\times_s\bar s[P]=X^s[P]$ identifies the underived geometric section functor. The specified resolution and slice comparisons give $D(E_R)Ra_*M\cong\mathcal K_R(M)$ and $U\mathcal K_R(M)\cong Rp_{X^s*}u^*M$ as derived objects.

source.place: Assembly from extracted returned proof steps 7, 8, 9

proof.text: With precisely these scalar and geometric comparisons, apply [lem-sfb-field-scalar-projection-mate-coherence]. Its two-adjunction mate equation identifies the coefficient projection with the statement's scalar transpose $\beta$, and its slice equation identifies forgotten $\beta$ with the displayed point projection. The same lemma gives coefficient restriction, input naturality and all canonical shift compatibilities.

source.place: Assembly from extracted returned proof steps 11, 12, 13

proof.text: For finite normed $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, apply [lem-sfb-field-free-orbit-norm-lisse-reconstruction] to the same field presentation, whose action-forgetting is restriction to $\bar s$ by step 4. The reconstruction of variable internal actions by continuous matrices and of morphisms by intertwiners gives its lisse restriction with realization $P\mapsto C(P,W)$, including rank zero and trivial $G$.

source.place: Assembly from extracted returned proof steps 14, 15, 16
